events.title: Demo v0.1.3: clearer text and new tips
events.summary: Demo v0.1.3 Next Fest is close, so the demo gets the same polish as the full game. This update is about words and tips: how the game plays has not changed. What is new Clearer text. Every line was reread in all 15 languages. Simpler everyday words, and one name for each thing everywhere: a chest is always a chest, a spell is always a spell. Upgrade tabs that say what they do. The tabs under UPGRADE are now called Castle Defense, Arrows, Supply Drops, Soldiers, Economy, Remnants, Overall Power. M

events.title: Demo v0.1.2: feedback button
events.summary: Demo v0.1.2 A small update that makes it easier to reach me. What is new Feedback button. On the preparation screen, right under the wishlist button, there is now a GIVE FEEDBACK button. It opens the Castellan discussions on Steam without leaving the game. Why I am a solo developer and your feedback decides what I work on next. Auto fire was added a few days ago because of one comment. events.title: Demo v0.1.1: auto fire
events.summary: Demo v0.1.1 The first feedback came in fast: holding the left mouse button the whole time tires your hand. Fair point, so here is a fix. What is new Auto fire. Press F in battle to switch it on or off. The castle keeps shooting where you aim, and you can still drag cards and cast spells as usual. Smaller control hints. The hints in the top left corner take up less space. Keep it coming I am a solo developer and I read everything. If something feels off, tell me and I will look at it. Thank you f

events.title: Castellan Demo is out now!
events.summary: The Castellan demo is live Hold the walls through the first three chapters, free on Steam. How it plays Aim every arrow yourself. The castle only shoots where you point. Open chests, draw soldier cards. Knights, archers, mages and healers. Deploy where the line is breaking. Every card you place is a decision. Bring down the boss at the end of each road. What is in the demo 3 chapters, each with its own enemies and boss The card and chest system, spells, and the first branches of the mastery tree
